instruction: Set the first picture's height to 24cm on slide 3 and adjust all textbox fonts to 38pt on slide 4.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires picture height 24cm on slide 3 (index 2, first picture) and font size 38pt on slide 4 (index 3). Slide 3 has picture with current height 21.12cm, slide 4 has textboxes with current font size 80pt.

scoring_breakdown.1.0: Both picture dimension and all text font sizes set correctly

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly checks both requirements: picture height on slide 3 and all text fonts on slide 4
Getter extracts picture dimension using python-pptx with correct EMU to cm conversion (360000 EMU = 1 cm)
Getter extracts all font sizes from text runs on slide 4
Metric correctly compares extracted values against expected with appropriate tolerances (0.2cm, 1pt)
Partial credit scoring (0.5 for picture, 1.0 for both) aligns with scoring_breakdown
Postconfig includes Ctrl+S to save file before evaluation, ensuring fresh state
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Getter uses shapes[picture_index] which gets the first shape (any type), not specifically the first picture. Could improve by filtering to picture shapes first: [s for s in slide.shapes if s.shape_type == MSO_SHAPE_TYPE.PICTURE][0]. However, this will work correctly if the first shape is indeed a picture as expected.
Minor: Font extraction checks all text shapes (not just textboxes), which is actually more comprehensive. If only textbox fonts should be verified, could filter by shape_type.
Minor: Font extraction only collects explicit font sizes (where run.font.size is not None), which is appropriate but could miss inherited font sizes.
